One focused change this pass, aimed at the CRITICAL that repeats on all three breakpoints: the headline's display face.

**Mechanism.** Exposure/Exposure-20 is licensed and has no WOFF2 in the repo, so `--font-display` falls through to Newsreader. The drawn optical weight 450 in Newsreader is a high-contrast Didone with thin stems, and it also sets ~10% narrow. Newsreader is loaded as a variable font (`font-weight: 200 800`), so the missing mass can be bought back on the weight axis instead of faked with tracking — the drawn `-0.04em` token stays exactly as defined.

I picked the weight by measurement rather than eye, summing glyph advances straight out of the subset WOFF2 on disk at the drawn 108px/-0.04em:

| wght | "AI compute at" | "the maritime edge." |
|---|---|---|
| 450 (shipped) | 600.7px (−10.9%) | 786.9px (−8.3%) |
| 700 | 644.9px (−4.3%) | 844.7px (−1.6%) |
| **750** | **659.0px (−2.2%)** | **862.9px (+0.6%)** |
| 800 | 673.3px (−0.1%) | 881.7px (+2.8%) |
| Figma | 674px | 858px |

The 450 row reproduces the reviewer's measured 603px/781px to within 0.5%, which calibrates the model; 750 is the balance point across both lines. It sits slightly above the reviewer's eyeballed ~600-700 suggestion, and the measurement is why.

**Companion edit (required, not scope creep):** the heavier face widens "AI compute at the" from ~308px to 338px at the 44px mobile size, which would have overflowed the 318px measure and orphaned "edge." onto a third line. The title inset is now `px-3` below the tablet frame (`md:px-6`, `lg:px-0` unchanged), giving 342px and keeping the two balanced mobile lines.

`tsc --noEmit`, `eslint src/app/sections/hero --max-warnings=0` and `npm run build` all pass.

Three things I deliberately left alone, recorded in the summary JSON:

- **The real Exposure/Matter files** — licensed, absent, and the stacks live in `src/app/fonts.ts` / `globals.css`, shared files owned by other agents this pass. The weight compensation belongs on `--text-display-xl--font-weight` in `globals.css` (it affects every display heading, not just the hero) once the real face lands or is ruled out.
- **The lead's 5-line wrap and the knock-on 30px CTA offset** — same missing-font root cause but a different axis: Inter has no width axis, so the levers are the shared stack or the drawn 431px column. Worth its own pass.
- **Vessel plate tone** — needs a re-export of `hero-vessel.png`; binary assets are off-limits and reverted.
